purpose: Falsify whether preserving production detector tracks across semantic target switches can safely support a narrow contradict-only correction.

inputs.rgb_universe: the already-burned 4422-frame CrowdBot production temporal A/B universe
inputs.detector: the same production YOLO11n FP16 model on strict Qualcomm QNN HTP
inputs.baseline: the immutable completed production temporal A/B R0 trace
inputs.truth: the immutable F1A table previously reduced to 8 scorable positive events and 7 negative windows

candidate.tracking: deterministic class/source-compatible greedy association using only current and past detector boxes
candidate.geometry: unchanged seven-observation unanimous log-box-height trend with absolute OLS slope >= 0.2 per second
candidate.proposed_intervention: only CONTRADICT_APPROACH may suppress a baseline feedback trigger; CONFIRM_APPROACH never creates or promotes an alert

predeclared_screen.benefit_gate: at least 2 of 7 negative windows lose all feedback triggers
predeclared_screen.harm_gate: all 8 scorable positive events retain at least one valid-window trigger
predeclared_screen.timing_gate: no retained positive event is delayed by more than one source frame
